basic_info.description: 4057 19th Street exemplifies Edwardian pride on a picturesque block in the heart of the Castro. This stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence seamlessly blends period charm with modern functionality. The spacious living room features classic bay windows and a decorative fireplace, while the formal dining area showcases timeless architectural details. The updated kitchen is ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a serene retreat, while the second bedroom provides flexibility as a guest room or home office. Enjoy the beautifully landscaped, south-facing backyard  perfect for gatherings with friends or as a peaceful urban escape. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, laundry, a large one-car garage, and ample storage. Just steps from the Castro's lively shops, corner grocery, Mollie Stone's Market, and beloved restaurants including the famed Anchor Oyster Bar plus easy access to public transit and iconic Dolores Park this home offers classic San Francisco living with a vibrant, urban edge.
